package.description: The SD Memory Card Formatter formats SD Memory Cards

en-US.description: The SD Memory Card Formatter formats SD Memory Cards
en-US.longDescription: The SD Memory Card Formatter formats SD Memory Card, SDHC Memory Card, SDXC Memory Card and SDUC Memory Card (respectively SD/SDHC/SDXC/SDUC Cards) complying with the SD File System Specification created by the SD Association (SDA).
en-US.name: SD Card Formatter

zh-CN.description: SD 存储卡格式化工具
zh-CN.longDescription: SD 存储卡格式化工具（SD Memory Card Formatter）可对符合 SD 协会（SDA）制定的 SD 文件系统规范的 SD 存储卡、SDHC 存储卡、SDXC 存储卡和 SDUC 存储卡（即 SD/SDHC/SDXC/SDUC 卡）进行格式化。

package.longDescription: The SD Memory Card Formatter formats SD Memory Card, SDHC Memory Card, SDXC Memory Card and SDUC Memory Card (respectively SD/SDHC/SDXC/SDUC Cards) complying with the SD File System Specification created by the SD Association (SDA).
package.name: SD Card Formatter
